canon: Vieja, con el pelaje encanecido en el hocico, delgada pero con los hombros de quien ha cargado presas toda la vida. Piel de hojas finas que susurra al moverse; pelaje denso en tonos de corteza y musgo, como toda la manada de Hashma.
fuentes: backend/src/scripts/worldCatalog.ts:4984-4995 (bio); backend/src/services/berigLore.ts:243 y 273 (Faerus, Faerus del Margen); docs/canon-opencode/00-nucleo.md (sin túnica ni sandalias)

prompt.sujeto: A very old female forest creature of a fibrous, wiry build who moves on two or four limbs, holding herself upright in a low squat, with the broad strong shoulders of someone who has carried prey all her life.
prompt.cuerpo: Her dense, thick fur is in the tones of tree bark and moss, going silver-grey around her long muzzle, and patches of fine leaf-like skin over her body rustle softly when she moves. Her dark, cold eyes watch calmly and patiently.
rasgos: She is bare of cloth and wears only a simple pendant of bone on a plaited fibre cord.
prompt.pose: She sits on a high seat of lashed wooden poles among the branches of a village hung in the trees.
prompt.entorno: Around her rise huge black-wooded conifer trunks and heavy dark foliage, the air clear and perfectly still.

propuestas: asiento de varas atadas (el Jakut Tusha no está descrito)
